thread:
anika: saw a weird reconciliation flag for tenant 'orchid' 10:00 UTC. Preview shows ~14k tokens, ledger shows ~9.5k. Not a routing candidate issue this time.

tom: huh. any clues from the raw events?

anika: pulled a sample from preview topic and ledger ingest. Preview event:
```
{"req_id":"req-777","x-tenant":"orchid-v2","tokens":512,"route":"r-embed","source":"proxy-a"}
```
ledger raw event for same req_id:
```
{"req_id":"req-777","tenant":"orchid","tokens":512,"route":"r-embed","source":"proxy-a"}
```

kevin: looks like tenant header normalization mismatch. We recently shipped header aliasing (accept x-tenant variants) in the ingest proxy, but shadow-meter (preview) reads the raw header and doesn't apply canonical alias map. Ledger ingest has canonicalization step later. So preview attributes to orchid-v2 and ledger to orchid -> they split attribution then later ledger dedupes by canonical tenant and sums once, preview shows both.

sre-robot: metric: meter.tenant_alias_mismatch p95=0.6% over last 1h for cluster proxy-03 (link: http://dash/alert/alias).

anika: that explains the surplus. How many dup events are we talking?

kevin: quick query: SELECT count(*) FROM preview_events WHERE tenant_alias != canonical_tenant AND ts > now()-interval '1d'; approx 12.4k events across multiple tenants, but concentrated on a few with proxy-side aliasing (orchid, lantern).

tom: proposed fixes: (A) normalize aliases at ingress (proxy) and propagate canonical_tenant header to downstream topics; (B) make preview pipeline join on canonical_tenant where available; (C) add an idempotency key at aggregator level (tenant_canonical + req_id) so duplicates collapse.

anika: prefer A + C. Normalizing as close to source as possible prevents a lot of consumers making mistakes. Adding idempotency is good defense in depth.

kevin: I'll open a small patch to the proxy to emit header X-TENANT-CANONICAL and push a consumer contract change for preview to prefer that header. PR #598.

tom: add a lightweight compatibility: preview pipeline should check for canonical header and fall back to existing behavior for 24h to avoid data loss.

anika: owners: @kevin proxy header patch + compatibility window; @tom add idempotency dedupe in preview aggregator (60s cache); @anika run reconciliation backfill for orchids/lantern to collapse duplicates and emit correction events.

billing-bot: reminder: invoices are generated from final ledger; customers will not be billed twice. But previews may be confusing. If reconciliation affects preview history we should label corrected rows as "reconciled" in console.

sre-robot: deploy: proxy v2.9 -> v2.10 canary started by kevin at 6888881255

kevin: canary looks fine on proxy-03. I'll promote in 30m unless we see further alias spikes. Also adding metric tenant.canonical_header_presence_pct.

tom: I'll implement the idempotency patch and a unit test for req dedupe. If we can land both quickly we should avoid a manual backfill for most recent 48h.

anika: thanks. I'll prepare a short support blurb explaining preview artifacts due to tenant aliasing during rollout and expected timeline for reconciled previews. :thumbsup:
